caseName: Gould-Mersereau Co. v. Williams Bros. Aircraft Corp.
caseNameFull: Gould-Mersereau Company v. Williams Bros. Aircraft Corporation
attorneys: Mr. William S. Pritchard, with whom Mr. Ernest G. Metcalfe was on the brief, for petitioner., Messrs. D. A. Using, Hervey S. Knight, and George L. Wilkinson were on the brief for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The decree of the Circuit Court of Appeals is reyersed upon the authority of Alexander Milbourn Co. v. Davis-Bournonville Co., 270 U. S. 390, and the cause is remanded to that court for reconsideration with special regard to the decision in that case.
